improvements.desc: Velocity on release: velAz/velPol set on flick, damped *0.92/frame. Fling keeps spinning then settles. 2 multiplies.
FOV lerps ONLY during warp transitions. Never touched in orbit mode — orbit stays stable.
Target lerps slower than rotation (dt*3 vs dt*6) — parallax weight when flying to a planet.

free_look.desc: Nathan: when zoomed into a planet, be able to look around — turn and face the sun if wanted.
free_look.law: When camera distance to the focused planet drops below the free-look threshold, drag switches from orbit-around-target to look-around: yaw/pitch the view direction from the camera position (first-person style). Wheel/pinch still dolly in/out. Dragging back out past the threshold returns to orbit mode.
constraints: no mode button — the threshold switch must feel seamless
mobile: one-finger drag looks, pinch zooms

rejected: 'lerping lerps' framing — both approaches lerp; the wins are inertia + rates + fov discipline
